author: PokerFace
body:
Hello! This is my 4th map for Avicus and my 1st contest map. I present to you Desolated Barracks! This is a TDM map with inspiration off of CS:GO. This is not an actual CS:GO map, but I saw my friends play and noticed there were many sniping points and this is what I tried to incorporate into my map. Hopefully you guys like it! 

Creator: PokerFace
Contributor: Zintenka
Server Host: alexanderjoe10
Gamemode: TDM
Players: 20vs20

Imgur Album: https://imgur.com/a/npd9D
Download: http://www.mediafire.com/download/lbvsdbbnzlf63ti/DesertCity.rar
YML: http://pastie.org/10280831
